A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified a new autoantibody in the setting of a new disease entity, GABABR-Ab associated encephalitis.
the immune system is not only important for tumor surveillance but also for tumor progression.

there is no one size fits all treatment plan for patients with paraneoplastic neurologic syndromes.
